description: This source file defines an abstract Java class 'OpenmrsPropertyEditor' that extends PropertyEditorSupport to facilitate converting 'OpenmrsObject' instances to and from their string representations. It provides methods to set an object from text (by ID or UUID) and to get text representation from the object.

classes.name: OpenmrsPropertyEditor
classes.description: An abstract class for property editors handling OpenmrsObject types, responsible for converting between object instances and their text representations.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a string to an OpenmrsObject by interpreting the string as an ID or UUID, then sets the value.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the string representation (ID) of the current OpenmrsObject, or empty string if null.
